reviews.comment: MEEN630 is a difficult class. It is very derivation heavy with little practical problem solving. This professor responds to email quickly and knows heat transfer well. The homework takes hours, he teaches out of five books, and homework solutions are often not provided before the exams. I would choose another professor if possible.

If you need a professor for Heat Transfer, this is your guy. All of the homework is straight from the textbook, and the quizzes and exams are open notes. He grades and gives out partial credit like it is charity. The quizzes and exams have questions similar to the homework so you can use the homework to answer them. Never studied and made an A.
A lot of build your own experiments. Presentation every week. 2 big reports with one having multiple revisions throughout semester. Good professor with clear grading criteria. Not a tough grader
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: The prof is nice and caring. Cares too much about the material. Spends more time deriving equations than doing problems. Ask him for help and he will help you.
